HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.02.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.94/2011 PS EOW under sections 406/420/467/468 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide MOU dated 21st January, 2013, which is on record of this Court.

Sr. Counsel for the petitioners states that all the elements of settlement have been duly complied with inter alia the payment of amount of Rs.5.21 crores has been made to respondent no.2 and possession of 19 immovable properties, as mentioned in Annexure B of the MOU, have been returned to respondent no.2.

3. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 confirms that all the terms of settlement have been complied with and out of 3 FIRs, which were sustained between the parties, 2 FIRs have already been quashed vide orders of Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana vide orders dated 10th December, 2018 and 27th October, 2016.

entities.text: High Court of Punjab and Haryana
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Consequently, the FIR No.94/2011 PS EOW under sections 406/420/467/468 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
